nonBlockingFindings: M1: runbook says create_ticket_order_v5 is already in production but all-context and the prior review-decision say migration 202611170001 is NOT applied; add a to_regprocedure check and reconcile docs before enabling checkout.

M2: a survey that never persists (save failure, 1500 ms timeout, serverless freeze) is unrecoverable and the paid order syncs with blank G/H/M undetected; add a paid-orders-without-survey query to the runbook; requeue cannot recover it.

M3: the always-on old-baseline sha256 test hashes raw bytes (autocrlf=true, no .gitattributes) and reads the active/ path; it breaks on a CRLF checkout and when the task is archived; normalize line endings and tolerate the completed/ path.
M4: consent/retention for survey data sent to the third-party Sheet is not a gate in the owner's production order; make it a precondition to enabling checkout.
M5: no scheduler and no retry cap; survey_read_failed adds a failure mode on the paid path; require a scheduler or manual sync routine before enabling checkout.
L1: requeue overwrites the whole A:Q row including hand edits.
L2: migration is not re-runnable (create table without if not exists).
L3: runbook lacks a PostgREST schema-reload fallback.
L4: CANDIDATE JSON overwritten per run; author capture only in scratchpad.
L6: aria-invalid on fieldset is not valid ARIA; use a data attribute.
L7: same-key retry with different answers overwrites while pending; small TOCTOU after payment.
